title: Camera Ke Bina Aag Dhoondhne Wala Robot 🔥 #shorts
description:
Ek robot bina camera ke candle ki aag dhoondh leta hai. Kaise? Ek chhote flame sensor module se!
🔥 Flame ke invisible infrared ki physics
🔬 Sensor ke andar silicon aur electrons ka khel
⚙️ LM393 comparator aur blue pot ka kaam
🔌 Arduino Uno se wiring aur code
Aise aur robot aur Arduino videos ke liye subscribe karo.
#shorts #arduino #flamesensor #robotics #firefightingrobot #hindi #electronics

Robot ke paas camera nahi, phir bhi aag dhoondh leta hai 🔥
Yeh ek chhote flame sensor ka kamaal hai, jo aag ki invisible infrared pakadta hai 👇
🔥 Aag infrared chhodti hai, jo aankh ko nahi dikhti
🔬 Sensor ke andar silicon electrons chhodta hai
⚙️ LM393 comparator output LOW kar deta hai
🔌 VCC 5V pe, DO D2 pe, aur dhoop se bachao
